label: Calendar X
purpose: Show calendar x as a direct object, concept, or themed surface cue.
why_not_approved_yet: The calendar-plus-x shape still drifts between remove event, blocked date, and disabled calendar without stronger nearby product context.

label: Move Down
depicts: A downward arrow or movement cue.
purpose: Show downward movement, downward navigation, or moving an item to a lower position.
why_not_approved_yet: The clock-and-arrow reading still mixes postpone, slow down, and move earlier or later too broadly.

label: Move Up
depicts: An upward arrow or movement cue.
purpose: Show upward movement, upward navigation, or moving an item to a higher position.
why_not_approved_yet: The clock-and-arrow reading still mixes reschedule, speed up, and move earlier or later too broadly.

label: Timed File

purpose: Show a file tied to time, schedule, or recency.
why_not_approved_yet: The file-and-clock shape still blends recent file, scheduled file, and time-limited file meanings.

label: User File

purpose: Show a file tied to a user, profile, or account record.
why_not_approved_yet: The file-and-user shape still drifts between profile document, account export, and user-owned file meanings.

label: Timed Folder
depicts: A folder paired with a clock cue.
purpose: Show a folder tied to time, schedule, or recency.
why_not_approved_yet: The folder-and-clock shape still blends recent folder, scheduled folder, and folder history meanings.

purpose: Show an open folder with an active, current, or highlighted marker.
why_not_approved_yet: The open-folder-and-dot shape still blends current folder, unread folder, and active folder meanings too broadly.
